question: How are the sons and mantra-holders of those practitioners ranked in distinction?
premises: The sons of the previously mentioned persons are included.
Mantra-holders are also included in this group.
Their distinction is said to occur in order.
inference: Therefore these sons and mantra-holders are distinguished in due order.
uncertainties: The exact referent of tat is context-dependent.
plain_english: Their sons and the mantra-holders are distinguished in due order.
